description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE L (k LONG CONSTRAINT PK_L PRIMARY KEY); Close; DBEngine.SetOption(dbImplicitCommitSync, "Yes"); OpenDatabase shared read/write. L(k LONG primary key) with keys 1..602 inserted ascending (r-q7 long-split: the root is rewritten under prefix 7f 80 00 and is full at 602), then 65536..65986 ascending (451 keys: a new one-entry rightmost leaf at 65536, rewritten under its common prefix 7f 80 01 when it fills under prefix 0, not full at 451), then 65535, then 65534: above the left leaf's last key (602), below the right leaf's first, not covered by the right leaf's stored prefix. Pages 44-59 whole after keys 602, 65536, 65986, 65535 and 65534. Asks which leaf takes the key and what that leaf stores.

args.text: CREATE TABLE L (k LONG CONSTRAINT PK_L PRIMARY KEY)
